purpose: Durable cross-chat memory for incidents, decisions and guardrails affecting content production and Flashcards integration.

reconsideration_protocol.rule: Before endorsing a proposal that conflicts with an ACTIVE decision below, surface the prior incident/conflict first instead of simply agreeing.
reconsideration_protocol.required_response_pattern: Tell Hossein what happened previously, explain how the new proposal could recreate it, state the safe default, and ask for explicit approval only if he still wants to supersede the guardrail.
reconsideration_protocol.override_rule: Explicit user approval is required; record a new decision with supersedes=[old id].

decisions.incident: Frequent/heavy Git operations and Git as a live execution dependency caused interruptions/timeouts and wasted production turns.
decisions.decision: Artifact-first async Git with bounded/deferred/coalesced synchronization. Content work must continue when Git persistence is pending.
decisions.required_warning: Hossein, we previously reduced GitHub's role because continuous/heavy Git activity caused interruptions. This proposal could reintroduce that failure mode.

decisions.incident: A newer Flashcards runtime may advance beyond the last fully verified runtime.
decisions.decision: When integration matters, target Flashcards CURRENT. LAST_FULLY_VERIFIED is regression/fallback reference only. Never downgrade integration because CURRENT has blockers.

decisions.incident: Source workstreams must not be silently rebuilt from memory/legacy mappings or unrelated sources.
decisions.decision: Use registered source identity + newest portable checkpoint; preserve source terminology, order, provenance and workstream separation.
No significant visible Flashcards UI/UX change without informing Hossein and receiving approval.
Large ZIP/checkpoint artifacts live in Library/Project/user-delivery. Git stores source and compact metadata/hashes, not Base64 archive reconstruction.

decisions.incident: Deferred/coalesced Git persistence made parallel chats capable of seeing stale content checkpoints and forced Hossein to think about synchronization manually.
decisions.decision: Every validated content milestone is synchronized automatically to its own workstream branch/checkpoint plus compact coordination metadata before handoff.
preserved_guardrails: large ZIPs stay in Library/Project, not Git

decisions.incident: Long tool-heavy turns sometimes completed substantial work but ended before a visible final answer reached Hossein, making progress look lost and increasing ambiguity about the resume point.
decisions.decision: Use durable turn boundaries: one major milestone per turn by default. After PASS/BLOCKED/durable checkpoint, persist state and send a visible final response before starting the next major stage. Use targeted reads, bounded tool-call budgets and one corrected retry per failed external operation.
preserved_guardrails: GitHub remains lightweight durability, not a blocking execution dependency.
CURRENT runtime is re-resolved when runtime compatibility matters.
No significant visible UI/UX change without approval.

decisions.incident: During the A1-L01 re-audit, an automatic proposal to split hören into two flashcards because it covered hear/listen was explicitly rejected by Hossein.
decisions.decision: For the same lexical word/target, multiple verified meanings stay on ONE flashcard and are all shown on the back. Do not create duplicate cards solely because a word is polysemous. Separate cards are allowed only when the source represents a genuinely distinct lexical target such as a different part of speech, homograph, or separate expression identity.
conflicts_with: duplicate cards for hear/listen-style meaning distinctions
decisions.required_behavior: Preserve one stable lexical card ID and enrich its back/definition/examples with the verified meanings; never split merely because dictionary senses differ.

decisions.incident: During Menschen A1 Verben finalization, wording about adding a fixed 'Menschen Verben' book raised concern that Book/Lesson names might become permanent or hard-coded.
decisions.decision: Library Book/Lesson/Deck organization is mutable runtime metadata/membership, not canonical card identity and not a set of hard-coded project constants. Imported names are initial seed labels only. Cards retain stable canonical IDs when organization labels are renamed or when future lessons/books are added.
decisions.current_runtime_note: v435-R69 derives Library containers generically from card source/lesson/deck values. A container exists when cards carry that label. Current delete actions remove contained cards; changing deletion to non-destructive unlinking is a separate data-loss/architecture decision and must not be changed silently.
decisions.required_behavior: Content projection may supply initial organization labels, but runtime code must not special-case Menschen titles. Future imports may add labels such as Menschen A2 Verben without changing existing canonical IDs.

decisions.incident: Menschen Stage5 projections emitted mixed card types such as german-verb and de-vocabulary. Runtime legacy behavior used german-verb as a Study-layout discriminator, producing inconsistent geometry across otherwise ordinary vocabulary cards.
decisions.decision: All ordinary German vocabulary projections share one neutral import/presentation envelope regardless of POS. POS/category/morphology/Rektion/expression metadata remain semantic fields only and must not choose a different Flashcard layout.
required_behavior: Sense/Expression projection is presentation-neutral across noun, verb, adjective, adverb, phrase and expression.
Do not encode POS as a layout-selecting card_type.
Legacy german-verb may be accepted for backward compatibility but new projection must target the neutral ordinary vocabulary card envelope.
Stage5 projection QA and Stage6 runtime acceptance must assert cross-POS presentation parity.

decisions.incident: A neutral outer type could previously coexist with hidden presentation selectors or rich verb metadata, allowing presentation identity to leak back out of semantics.
decisions.decision: Presentation identity and linguistic semantics are orthogonal. New ordinary vocabulary uses explicit de-vocabulary plus gfp-vocabulary-neutral@1; POS/morphology/gender/Rektion/structure remain semantic. Presentation-selector namespaces are closed recursively and case-insensitively; source_schema_profile is provenance-only. Runtime inference is legacy fallback only when supported explicit type is absent.

decisions.incident: The old NVV run became blocked because the exact Batch0003 portable authority could no longer be materialized, while historical metadata still claimed 126 completed-or-bounded-PASS cards.
decisions.decision: Hossein explicitly authorized restarting the standalone NVV production from zero. The registered source remains authoritative; all prior generated NVV batches/cards/checkpoints are archive/audit evidence only and do not seed the new run.
decisions.explicit_user_approval: Hossein explicitly chose a clean restart from zero on 2026-09-30.
supersedes_workstream_rules: previous Batch0001-0003 preservation as working authority
preserves: source fidelity and registered source identity

decisions.incident: The stage-safe controller plus a stale NVV preset caused repeated stop/recovery cycles and re-injected historical Batch0003/126-card recovery text. A 75-second orphan watchdog was also too aggressive for long reasoning/tool operations, making a ~2.5k-target workstream impractically chatty and slow.
decisions.decision: Hossein explicitly approved a scoped long-run AUTORUN override for NVV. Use Project-aware Custom + continuous_safe/CONTINUOUS_SAFE. Process Stage3 as ~500-target superbatches composed of <=200-target atomic shards, persist lightweight resume state after each shard, keep full QA/checkpointing at meaningful boundaries, and auto-continue across turns without routine user confirmation. Historical pre-restart NVV output remains quarantine-only.
decisions.explicit_user_approval: Hossein explicitly requested rebuilding the AUTORUN setup from scratch for the ~2000+ card NVV workload on 2026-09-30.
decisions.relationship_to_MEM_008: SCOPED_USER_OVERRIDE_FOR_NVv_ONLY; preserves durable checkpoints and visible summaries at real turn boundaries while removing mandatory stop-after-every-shard behavior.
preserved_guardrails: CURRENT runtime resolution only when integration matters

propagation_rule.rule: Do not duplicate memory text inside every workstream folder because copies drift. Keep root PROJECT-MEMORY.json authoritative; every new workstream/checkpoint/handoff must reference PROJECT-MEMORY.json and GIT-SYNC-POLICY.json.
propagation_rule.existing_workstreams: Root bootstrap applies this memory to existing workstreams even when older CHECKPOINT.json files do not yet contain explicit pointers.
